#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct RunCounter {
    int previous;
    int runLength;
    int answer;
    bool started;

    RunCounter() : previous(0), runLength(0), answer(0), started(false) {}

    void add(int c) {
        if (!started) {
            previous = c;
            runLength = 1;
            started = true;
        } else if (c == previous) {
            runLength++;
        } else {
            if ((runLength & 1) == 0)
                answer++;
            previous = c;
            runLength = 1;
        }
    }

    int result() {
        if (started && (runLength & 1) == 0)
            answer++;
        return answer;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    string s;
    getline(cin, s);

    RunCounter counter;
    for (char ch : s) {
        counter.add((int)ch);
    }

    cout << counter.result() << "\n";
    return 0;
}
